f2_target.claim_scope_observed: event-time metadata; clock-domain identity; bounded skew/uncertainty; freshness; explicit UNKNOWN/UNALIGNED temporal relation; deterministic explicit fusion window; preserve disagreement; fail closed against arrival-order/same-cycle assumptions

mapping.note: ROS synchronizers use message/header timestamps; Python arrival-time synchronization exists but is explicitly discouraged as unpredictable.
ApproximateTime uses bounded per-input queues and drops the oldest message on overflow.
C++ policy exposes max_interval_duration; Python exposes slop.
C++ detects out-of-order stamps but only warns; F2 must preserve stronger fail-closed/typed handling.
ApproximateTime operates on rclcpp::Time extracted by TimeGetter but does not provide F2's explicit per-observation clock-domain compatibility/uncertainty state.
No equivalent first-class epistemic relation was identified in the audited policy; F2 should retain its native representation.
The synchronizer emits matched tuples; it is not a world-truth or contradiction-preservation system.
ROS invalidates/recomputes an active candidate when queue overflow drops a source message; adopt only if F2 implementation actually maintains cross-call candidates.

integration_decision.reason: Dependency and semantic surface is larger than the deterministic typed F2 observation-window primitive; the useful invariants are small and already substantially present in WP-711 scope.
source_supported_test_additions: arrival-order permutation must not change an admissible event-time fusion result
out-of-order source-local timestamp must be rejected or explicitly typed rather than silently normalized
fusion span just above the bound must fail closed
bounded per-source overflow must preserve deterministic diagnostics
headerless/arrival-time fallback must not silently enter the canonical fusion path

counterhypothesis: No candidate-invalidation state machine is needed if WP-711 computes fusion sets atomically from immutable bounded snapshots; importing that ROS mechanism would add state without information gain.
architecture_delta: NO_NEW_DELTA: current WP-711 contract is stricter than the donor on clock domains and epistemic uncertainty. Feed the source-supported edge-case tests to Trigger4, but do not broaden architecture or import ROS2.
